verdict.rationale: Data-flow and reactivity model is a fair axis for a React-based UI framework, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents unidirectional or explicit data flow, or contrasts it with two-way binding. The cited items cover streaming, async components, server functions, routing and caching, none of which address tracing state changes through predictable data flow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace state changes through explicit, predictable data flow instead of debugging implicit two-way bindings
